Subject: Observability add-ons pricing — retention, tracing & dashboards

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the tracing timeline and live dashboards looked like a great fit for several of our SRE and analytics teams. Procurement asked me to follow up with: a single consolidated SKU that covers retention tiers for traces, a per-seat vs. metered story for dashboards, and any short-term pilot credit you can provide so we can validate cost at scale.

High-level context: Nimbus is running three clusters (prod/preproc/analytics), roughly 1.2B traces/month, and we plan to ramp to ~2.5B by Q4. We need a clear migration path (commit bands) and a view of overage smoothing.

Can you share a compact pricing worksheet and indicate whether you can bundle tracing retention with advanced dashboards (we'd prefer a single P&L line). Also curious about whether there's a separate SLA uplift or surge capacity fee for retention-heavy bursts.

Attached is a short note from our procurement team with forecasting numbers (procurement@nimbushealth.com is CC'd).

Thanks — can we aim for a short call Thursday to review options?

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Reed
Head of Platform Engineering
Nimbus Health

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons pricing — retention, tracing & dashboards

Sarah — thanks for the clear context and numbers (very helpful). I'm looping in Laura from Pricing and Rishi from Solutions to give you a concise workbook and 3 packaging scenarios ahead of Thursday.

Quick answers up front:
- We can offer a consolidated add-on SKU that bundles tracing retention, advanced dashboards, and a lightweight insights tier.
- Pricing model options: 1) Commit-based slab (monthly committed volume + overage at blended rate), 2) Metered (pay-as-you-go / per-trace ingest), 3) Hybrid (commit for base + metered overage).
- Short pilot credits: we can provide 8k USD equivalent credits for a 30-day trial, conditional on a follow-up usage review and a commitment conversation.
- Surge handling: there is an optional surge cushion (40% burst) at a small premium; alternatively we can do automatic smoothing for the first 90 days post-go-live.

I attached an initial workbook (obs_pricing_workbook.xlsx) with scenario rows for the numbers you sent. Laura will highlight the discount bands and concession paths so procurement has something concrete to work with.

I can do Thursday 11:00-11:30 PT — does that work?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales, Add-ons
Redwood Inference

Attachments: obs_pricing_workbook.xlsx (spreadsheet, 86KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Observability add-ons pricing — retention, tracing & dashboards

Hi Sarah — Laura from Pricing here. I reviewed the workbook and sketched three concrete commercial constructs below (numbers in the workbook tab "Nimbus Options").

Option A — Commit slab (recommended if you want predictable unit economics)
- 12 month term, committed traces: 1.5B/month baseline
- Bundle includes: 90-day raw retention for traces, advanced dashboards (unlimited seats but feature-graded), and trace dedup + KV cache for queries
- Base price: $48k/month (committed rate, blended token-equivalent pricing)
- Overages: $0.038 per 1k traces beyond commit; 60-day settlement window
- Discounts: 10% at signature, additional 5% at ARR > $600k

Option B — Hybrid (recommended for ramp)
- 6 month pilot + 18 month optional conversion
- Commit 800M/month, metered for overage at $0.045 per 1k traces
- Pilot credits: $8k credit to be applied against metered overage or first month invoice
- Surge cushion: 30% automatic smoothing, above that charged at 50% of list surge fee

Option C — Metered (minimal commitment)
- No term commitment; $0.052 per 1k traces, dashboards billed per-seat at $12/user/month for advanced features
- Recommended if usage is uncertain; higher unit cost but flexible

Concession / Discount playbook
- If Nimbus signs a 12-month commit and provides a 12-month forecasting cadence, we can extend discount to 15% on Option A (subject to legal SLA terms).
- We can include a one-time SOW (SOW_Nimbus_v2.pdf) for migration services and a 30-day release window for audit logs.

Open items I want to confirm on the call:
1) Which cluster(s) will be in the scope of the commit (prod only or prod+analytics)?
2) Do you need tracing hot retention beyond 90 days? (We can extend at a marginal price)
3) Billing cadence preference (monthly vs. quarterly in arrears)

Happy to walk the workbook live on Thursday at 11:00 PT.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Pricing Lead, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Laura / Tessa — thanks, this is exactly the level of detail procurement wanted. We reviewed Option B internally and have two asks before the call: 

1) Can you sketch a 9-month conversion path from Option B -> Option A with a defined discount ladder (we'd like visibility into how our unit price improves as we commit more)?
2) On the pilot credits: please confirm the credit application mechanics (invoice line or credit memo) and whether credit can be used against migration SOW.

If you can send those two small pieces today, we can go into Thursday's meeting ready to align on signatures. We prefer monthly billing and will scope pilot across prod + analytics clusters.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — procurement will be on the call and we expect a decision window of two weeks after the review.

Best,
Sarah
